title: Write a Background Task: Schedules, Locks and Monitoring | Orchard Core
description:
Some work does not belong in a web request: cleaning a cache, publishing scheduled content, retrying a failed job. In Orchard Core, a background task is a class that the background service runs on a schedule, for each tenant.

This video shows how to write one: implement IBackgroundTask, describe it with the BackgroundTask attribute, register it, see it in the admin, make it atomic on a web farm with a distributed lock, configure the background service, and read the state of the tasks from code.

In this video:
• How background tasks run
• Write a task
• Describe the task: title, schedule and options
• Register the task
• See it in the admin
• Atomic tasks and web farms
• Configure the service
• Hook into every run
• Read the state from code
